当前 macOS 版本尚未经过 Apple 公证。确认安装包来自 Nexlet: The current macOS build is not notarized by Apple. Once you have confirmed that your download comes from the official Nexlet GitHub Releases, follow these steps.
将 DMG 中的 Nexlet 拖入「应用程序」文件夹。: Drag Nexlet from the DMG into the Applications folder.
从「应用程序」打开 Nexlet；如出现「Apple 无法验证 Nexlet」提: Open Nexlet from Applications. If macOS says Apple could not verify Nexlet, click Done.
打开「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」，向下找到 Nexlet 的拦截提示，点击「仍: Go to System Settings → Privacy & Security. Scroll down to the notice about Nexlet and click Open Anyway.
按提示验证密码或 Touch ID，再确认「打开」。: Authenticate with your password or Touch ID when prompted, then confirm Open.
没有看到「仍要打开」？请重新尝试打开 Nexlet，再回到该设置页面。: No Open Anyway button? Try opening Nexlet again, then return to this settings page.
